comparison.objective: Stop a grinder and wait for wheel run-down before retrieving a part; candidate adjusts a de-energized damper then operates guarded cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Button actuation, temporal waiting, and safe retrieval versus tool alignment, collar tuning, counterholding, locking, and dynamic inspection.
comparison.success_condition: STOP precedes approach and wheel must fully stop after about 17 s versus de-energized adjustment followed by two acceptable impact cycles. Grinder record omits approach-zone and zero-speed thresholds.
comparison.reason: They share lockout-style sequencing but test different manipulation and outcomes.
